fresh_loco_donors: all target contexts except the target
wind_distance: prefix RMSE over raw causal local (u,v), fixed physical scale 1 m/s
primary_outcome: ten-stop Bernoulli reachability Brier source ordering

comparators.static_development_mixture: equal empirical mixture of all 10 development contexts and six members
comparators.oracle_same_context: six predictive members from the target context
comparators.development_nearest: at each stop, nearest development context under causal wind-prefix RMSE
comparators.fresh_loco_nearest: at each stop, nearest other fresh context under causal wind-prefix RMSE

pass_rule: lower mean normalized true-source rank than static mixture, one-sided exact sign p <= 0.01, and no target-context mean-rank reversal

interpretation.development_nearest_pass: current training support contains usable online-wind transport matching
interpretation.fresh_loco_only_pass: online wind contains a diversity signal but the current single-family development support is inadequate
interpretation.neither_pass: no demonstrated sufficiency; does not prove intrinsic impossibility because donor airflow support is sparse
